Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Make no bones about it**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Make no bones about it"** means to be direct, clear, and honest about something without hesitation or ambiguity. (स्पष्ट और ईमानदार होना) • **Example:** He made no bones about his dislike for the new policy and spoke openly against it. • It is used when someone expresses their thoughts or opinions in a straightforward manner without sugar-coating their words. (बिना झिझक या संकोच के अपनी बात रखना) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To hesitate before speaking** (बोलने से पहले झिझकना): Refers to being uncertain or pausing before expressing thoughts. • **Example:** He hesitated before speaking in the meeting, unsure of how his ideas would be received. • **Option 2: To remain neutral** (निष्पक्ष रहना): Refers to not taking sides in a conflict or argument. • **Example:** The mediator remained neutral throughout the discussion to resolve the dispute. • **Option 4: To confuse the listener** (श्रोता को भ्रमित करना): Refers to speaking in a way that creates misunderstanding or lack of clarity. • **Example:** His vague explanation confused the listener and led to further questions. 10c:Ta50, The correct answer is: **Enduring**.
